## Selected Projects

### [ZenXChat](https://github.com/CoreCoderX/ZenXChat)
A multi-LLM chat platform built around provider abstraction and BYOK security. The UI is simple — the engineering underneath isn't. Real-time SSE streaming, model routing, and conversation state.

![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=E07355) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=E07355) ![BYOK](https://img.shields.io/badge/BYOK-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![SSE Streaming](https://img.shields.io/badge/SSE%20Streaming-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Provider Abstraction](https://img.shields.io/badge/Provider%20Abstraction-1C1C1E?style=flat-square)

### [BankBackendApp](https://github.com/CoreCoderX/BankBackendApp)
Most banking tutorials stop at CRUD. This one doesn't. Multi-factor authentication (OTP, 2FA, TOTP), idempotent UPI transfers, ledger-based accounting, reconciliation jobs, and dispute management — built with Spring Boot to understand how the real thing works internally.

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=data%3Aimage%2Fsvg%2Bxml%3Bbase64%%%2BPC9zdmc%2B) ![Spring Boot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spring%20Boot-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=springboot&logoColor=E07355) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=postgresql&logoColor=E07355) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=redis&logoColor=E07355) ![2FA / TOTP](https://img.shields.io/badge/2FA%20%2F%20TOTP-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Idempotent UPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Idempotent%20UPI-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Ledger Accounting](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ledger%20Accounting-1C1C1E?style=flat-square)

### [Keymontr](https://github.com/CoreCoderX/Keymontr)
Secret detection is easy. False-positive reduction isn't. Keymontr scans source code for exposed credentials using multi-language pattern matching, lockfile exclusions, build output filtering, and structural detection gates.

![GNU Bash](https://img.shields.io/badge/CLI%20Tool-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=gnubash&logoColor=E07355) ![Secret Detection](https://img.shields.io/badge/Secret%20Detection-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Pattern Matching](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pattern%20Matching-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![False-Pos Reduction](https://img.shields.io/badge/False--Pos%20Reduction-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Multi-language](https://img.shields.io/badge/Multi--language-1C1C1E?style=flat-square)

### ZenXHub *(Active Development)*
The part of AI applications most people skip: the infrastructure. An offline-first model discovery catalog with stale-while-revalidate caching, provider runtime abstraction, and a CLI/TUI developer interface.

![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=E07355) ![GNU Bash](https://img.shields.io/badge/CLI%20%2F%20TUI-1C1C1E?style=flat-square&logo=gnubash&logoColor=E07355) ![AI Infrastructure](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI%20Infrastructure-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Local-First](https://img.shields.io/badge/Local--First%20Cache-1C1C1E?style=flat-square) ![Provider Routing](https://img.shields.io/badge/Provider%20Routing-1C1C1E?style=flat-square)

## How I Think

| Phase | Core Focus | Engineering Mindset |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01. THINK** | **First Principles** | Don't rush to implement. First ask why it needs to exist. |
| **02. BUILD** | **Pragmatic Simplicity** | Start simple and make it work. Complexity earned is architecture; complexity assumed is tech debt. |
| **03. BREAK** | **Edge-Case Driven** | Edge cases aren't bugs—they are requirements you haven't understood yet. |
| **04. UNDERSTAND** | **Deep Diagnostics** | Read the source code, trace data paths, and challenge abstractions. |
| **05. IMPROVE** | **Feedback Loop** | `BUILD` &nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp; `BREAK` &nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp; `UNDERSTAND` &nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp; `REBUILD` |

> *"Don't just use the system. Understand the system."*
